evidence: The existing surface-field normal term trains only the implicit field because Gaussian normals are detached in the offset branch. Tangent mean constraints degraded local planarity, while conservative center projection was visually neutral.
goal: Use detached SDF gradients as a continuous orientation target for Gaussian covariance normals without moving Gaussian centers.
fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, SDF adaptive-gradient blend 0.50, split threshold 5e-5, no tangent means and no center projection.
parallel_policy: Exactly six variants submitted concurrently, with expandable CUDA segments enabled.
robustness_policy: Incomplete K5-test3 and K9-test7 manifests are used only after all six training runs complete.
